g.title: title
g.text: DeepSeekMoE: fine-grained experts, shared isolation, grouped routing

g.title: subtitle
g.text: DeepSeek-V3 configuration (671B total / 37B activated) · one of 61 transformer layers

g.title: b_title
g.text: · 256 routed experts in 8 groups of 32, plus 1 shared

g.title: b_notes
g.text: : 256 small FFNs replace a few large ones,
patterns, freeing the routed experts to specialize
: keep 4 of 8 groups by their top-2 scores,
then 8 experts inside them — bounds all-to-all traffic

g.title: b_flow
g.text: score 256 experts → keep 4 groups → keep 8 experts → gated sum + shared

g.title: cfg
g.text: 256 routed + 1 shared expert per MoE layer
top-8 routed experts after top-4 groups

g.title: gate
g.text: scores all 256 routed experts; group scores then pick the active set
